verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents reusable, organization-scoped HTTP webhook destinations that attach to monitored alert rules. Because those rules can be built from any SQL query with an operator, threshold, interval, and severity, a programmatic consumer can receive outbound callbacks when conditions fire. The only events in evidence are these SQL-driven alerts, with no general platform event subscriptions, so this covers roughly half the story. Missing for 10: platform or lifecycle event types (cluster, job, or schema changes), a documented payload schema, delivery guarantees such as retries or signing, a webhook management API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
